messages:
deploy-bot: config-only rollout submitted by @jamie: cfg-2026-04-splayfold-01. change window 03:30-03:45 UTC. plan: canary 4% for 7m -> ramp to 20% if green. observability hooks on.

jamie: tweak is routing ballast + reduce microbatch to lower median latency. no model change.

ale: paste diff pls

jamie: { routing_policy: 'ballast-v1', microbatch_ms: 6, max_batch_size: 20, request_timeout_ms: 3000, tenant_qps: 50 }

oncall: suggested rollback triggers: p95 > baseline+30ms sustained 3m OR error-rate > 1.2% for 4m. also fail if synthetic smoke fails 2x.

ale: adding smoke assert to deploy-bot: check header `x-serving-cfg` and 200 + latency < 320ms. committing.

jamie: starting canary now, marking 4% traffic.

deploy-bot: deploy started by jamie at 2026-03-22T03:30:10Z. change-id cfg-2026-04-splayfold-01. canary_fraction: 0.04.

oncall: first 5 mins look ok: p95 ~ baseline + 10ms, errors 0.1%. kvcache stable.

jamie: ramp to 20% at +7m if no alerts.

deploy-bot: ramp executed at 2026-03-22T03:37:30Z -> 20%.

onecall: within 90s after ramp, error-rate climbed to 1.6% on a small tenant cohort, p95 to baseline+40ms. hitting rollback threshold.

jamie: aborting rollout and rolling back now.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated by jamie at 2026-03-22T03:38:45Z. previous config reapplied. traffic back to baseline in ~35s.

onecall: post-rollback: metrics stable, errors back to baseline. recommend follow-up: test routing ballast heuristic under burst + kvcache locality.

ale: filing ticket TKT-7892 with logs & sample traces. changelog note: cfg-2026-04-splayfold-01 attempted, rolled back due to transient p95/error regression on subset.

jamie: thanks, will iterate on tie-breaker and re-run a smaller canary after patch.
